posts.title: Art
posts.description: Art I once lucked into a private tour of a Monet gallery. I asked the curator, "these paintings just don't look great, why should I be impressed?" The curator responded that Monet, and impressionism in general, were a reaction to the then-new invention of paint sold in tubes. posts.title: Sort by Newest
posts.description: Sort by Newest Life pro tip: Google Maps thinks restaurant reviews from years ago are the "most relevant" reviews. Things change. Restaurants decline, get new owners, etc. Sorting by Newest has proven much more informative for me.

posts.title: LLMs: The standard is not perfection
posts.description: LLMs: The standard is not perfection Right now, LLMs are shaking up the way we live life and access information. There's a lot of debate around how useful they can be if they'll lie to you. Everything lies to you When I get info from an LLM, I affectionately tell folks "the hallucination box says..." But this isn't unique to LLMs! Google searches are full of incorrect or inapplicable information.
